visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: AND and OR Mixed Up
visualizerParams.problemDescription: 2024 is a leap year, but the program says it is not.

solution.explanation: The rule is: (divisible by 4 and not by 100) or divisible by 400. Swapping the operators demands divisibility by 400 for every year, so ordinary leap years like 2024 are rejected.
